verdict.rationale: Blaxel's docs say sandboxes scale to zero after a few seconds of inactivity and resume from standby in under 25ms, even after weeks. Separate docs cover archiving a sandbox to keep its filesystem while shut down and unarchiving it later, plus point-in-time snapshots with rollback and fork. Together these cover the core pause/resume-with-state story. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that in-memory/process state survives standby, a documented user-triggered pause API (standby is inactivity-driven), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
